description: This file defines a class 'DynamicStructuredTool' for creating and executing dynamic HTTP request tools within a larger framework, including utility functions, class methods, and detailed usage instructions.

classes.name: DynamicStructuredTool
classes.description: A class for creating dynamic tools that perform HTTP requests with customizable schemas, headers, and code execution.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Executes the tool with provided arguments, handling schema validation, callback management, and invoking the internal _call method.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Performs the HTTP request by constructing URL and options, executing custom code sandbox, and returning the response.

methods.name: setVariables
methods.description: Sets variables used in code sandbox execution.

methods.name: setFlowObject
methods.description: Sets the flow object for sandbox context.

methods.name: isStrict
methods.description: Returns whether the tool operates in strict mode.
